description: This Java source file defines the EventController class which handles web requests related to event management in a Spring MVC application. It includes methods for creating new events and processing form submissions, relies on several service and repository classes, and uses annotations for dependency injection and request mapping.

classes.name: EventController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing event creation and registration.

methods.name: newEvent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for creating a new event. Initializes an Event object and retrieves user-specific client list.

methods.name: registerEvent
methods.description: Processes POST requests for creating a new event, parsing input date-time, associating the event with the authenticated user, saving it, and returning the result view.
